title: Accra Life hairstyle catalogue
purpose: Canonical asset brief for realistic, interchangeable hairstyles on player characters and NPCs.
important: These styles are requested targets, not yet implemented or included in the current six GLB body/outfit files. Do not show a style as selectable until its hair asset has been created, rig-tested, and added to the game.

rules.genderAvailability: All styles are available to male and female characters unless a future specific asset has a technical limitation. Do not hard-lock hairstyles by gender.
rules.culture: Prioritise Ghanaian and wider African hair traditions while including contemporary global styles.
rules.realism: Use separate, properly modelled hair meshes or validated head-attached assets; avoid the old cartoon primitive hair as the final player/NPC solution.
rules.variation: Support multiple lengths, partings, hairlines, curl patterns, braid thicknesses, and dark/natural colour shades where appropriate.
rules.accessories: Headwear such as durags, headwraps, beads, clips, bands, and hair ties should be optional layers and must not permanently replace the underlying hairstyle.
rules.performance: Use reusable instanced/cached assets, sensible LODs, and reduced strand detail for distant crowds and mobile devices.
rules.npcDistribution: Choose varied hairstyles deterministically per NPC identity so an NPC keeps the same look after reload; avoid repeating the same style on every nearby pedestrian.
rules.roleCompatibility: Police, security, medical, transport, market, and hospitality uniforms may add approved caps/headwear while preserving the underlying hair choice when practical.

implementationStages: Create and license/source the individual hairstyle assets.
Fit each style to both male and female head rigs and validate deformation during idle, walk, and run.
Add hairstyle selection to the player character creator and barber shop.
Add persistent hairstyle IDs to player appearance saves.
Randomise stable hairstyle choices across NPCs, including police and occupational NPCs, with role-compatible headwear.
Add LOD/caching and test crowd performance on iPhone and ordinary desktop hardware.
